'''Jnoofot''' (pronounced "Geeknew-fot") was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. He resided at [[Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium]] where he hired out his services for five hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Game" />
